leadText: Pokémon Adventures: The Mythical Moltres is the eleventh monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Mato. It contains chapter twenty-six of the . The chapter originally released in this book was later rereleased as part of . As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.
